name: alerta-segura
description: Plataforma de apoio e denuncia de violencia domestica (Alerta Segura)

scripts.setup: npm install && npm run db:generate --workspace backend && npm run db:deploy --workspace backend && npm run db:seed --workspace backend
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace backend && npm run build --workspace frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace backend && npm run typecheck --workspace frontend
